text: Project loading page: search like idea search, j/k list, graph thumbnails
description: Typing filters recent and nearby projects; a unique folder-name/path match is highlighted and Enter opens it. Tab (no folder completion showing) moves into the list; j/k navigate, e edits the path, Escape returns to the input. Number shortcuts removed (supersedes 033c340d). Graph view stores a WebGL screenshot per project in IndexedDB (3 s after opening, then every minute); shown beside each entry. Commit c6972eb.

status.comment:
Specs + pnpm check 25/25. Live: filter, perfect-match highlight, Tab/j/Escape verified in the running UI. Thumbnail capture not verifiable headless (no requestAnimationFrame); Felix to see thumbnails appear after opening a project's graph.

Outcome: Project discovery now skips .test-tmp directories (DISCOVERY_IGNORED_DIRS); the discovery test plants a leftover test project and asserts it is not found. Effectiveness: Backend discovery test passes; pnpm check 25/25. Lesson: Test fixtures that outlive their run leak into user-facing lists; ignore their directory at the scanner.
